hypothesis: The direct Viterbi path has strong pooled signal but catastrophic well tails. A parameter-free rowwise fusion can retain globally consistent Viterbi states only when their disagreement with the forward posterior mean is commensurate with the forward posterior uncertainty.

discovery_population.source: Official training wells excluding the original 32 HMM discovery wells, 24 smoother wells, 24 direct-Viterbi wells, and every current test-well ID.
discovery_population.selection: First 32 wells after SHA256 sort of the literal prefix viterbi_confidence_v1: plus well ID.

frozen_fusion.forward_path: posterior mean from the frozen dip-rate HMM

confirmation_if_discovery_passes.population: All remaining non-test wells excluding all four HMM discovery sets.

stop_rule: If discovery fails any gate, stop permanently without changing the analytic fusion equation, HMM/Viterbi parameters, scale, clip, wells, or gates. Passing authorizes one unchanged confirmation only, not a submission.
